### Sensient Technologies Corporation Reports Results for the Quarter Ended September 30, 2026


October 30, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/397383768/files/doc_news/2026/Oct/30/SensientReportsResultsforQuarterEndedSeptember302026.pdf)


MILWAUKEE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Sensient Technologies Corporation (NYSE: SXT), a leading provider of flavors and colors for the food, pharmaceutical, and personal care markets, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Third Quarter Consolidated Results**


- Reported revenue increased 10.6% to $455.8 million in the third quarter of 2026 versus last year’s third quarter results of $412.1 million. On a local currency basis (1), revenue increased 10.2%.
- Reported operating income increased 25.5% to $72.4 million compared to $57.7 million recorded in last year’s third quarter. In the third quarter of 2025, the Company recorded $3.3 million of costs related to its Portfolio Optimization Plan versus no costs recorded in the third quarter of 2026 Local currency adjusted operating income (1) and local currency adjusted EBITDA (1) were up 18.6% and 15.4%, respectively, in the third quarter.
- Reported earnings per share increased 29.9% to $1.13 in the third quarter of 2026 compared to 87 cents in the third quarter of 2025. Local currency adjusted diluted EPS (1) increased 17.7% in the third quarter.


*“Sensient delivered an exceptional third quarter, with results that reflect the strength of our strategy and unwavering focus on our customers. As we look ahead, I am encouraged by the momentum across our business, the opportunities in our markets, and the investments we are making to support growth. I remain very confident about our performance in 2026 and beyond,”* said Paul Manning, Sensient’s Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer.

The Flavors & Extracts Group reported third quarter 2026 revenue of $210.0 million, an increase of $7.0 million versus the prior year’s third quarter. The Group’s revenue increase was driven primarily by higher prices and volume growth. Segment operating income was $30.5 million in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $2.5 million compared to the prior year’s third quarter.


The Color Group reported revenue of $210.3 million in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $32.2 million compared to the prior year’s third quarter. The Group’s revenue increase was driven primarily by strong volume growth. Segment operating income was $46.1 million in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $8.3 million compared to the prior year’s third quarter results.


The Asia Pacific Group reported revenue of $47.3 million in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $5.2 million compared to the prior year’s third quarter. The Group’s revenue increase was driven by strong volume growth and higher prices across the Group. Segment operating income was $12.4 million in the quarter, an increase of $2.8 million compared to the prior year’s third quarter.


Corporate & Other reported operating expenses were $16.5 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $17.6 million of operating expenses reported in the prior year’s third quarter. Local currency adjusted operating expenses(1) for Corporate & Other increased $2.2 million compared to the prior year’s third quarter. The higher operating expenses were primarily due to higher performance-based compensation costs in the third quarter.

**USE OF NON-GAAP FINANCIAL MEASURES**


The Company’s non-GAAP financial measures eliminate the impact of certain items, which, depending on the measure, include: currency movements, depreciation and amortization, Portfolio Optimization Plan costs, and non-cash share-based compensation. These measures are provided to enhance the overall understanding of the Company’s performance when viewed together with the GAAP results. Refer to “ *Reconciliation of Non-GAAP Amounts* ” at the end of this release.

To participate in the conference call, contact Chorus Call Inc. at (844) 492-3726 or (412) 317-1078, and ask to join the Sensient Technologies Corporation conference call. Alternatively, the call can be accessed by using the webcast link that is available on the Investor Information section of the Company’s web site at[www.sensient.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sensient.com&esheet=54631214&newsitemid=20261029016095&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sensient.com&index=1&md5=85c306a58d15cf80cafd27286504769e) .

**ABOUT SENSIENT TECHNOLOGIES**


Sensient Technologies Corporation is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of colors, flavors, and other specialty ingredients. Sensient uses advanced technologies and robust global supply chain capabilities to develop specialized solutions for food and beverages, as well as products that serve the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and personal care industries. Sensient’s customers range in size from small entrepreneurial businesses to major international manufacturers representing some of the world’s best-known brands. Sensient is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.
